title: R Bindings for the CaDiCaL SAT Solver
text: R bindings CaDiCaL, modern CDCL Boolean satisfiability (SAT) solver Armin Biere colleagues. CaDiCaL sources bundled, nothing install beyond package C++ compiler.

title: R Bindings for the CaDiCaL SAT Solver
R Bindings for the CaDiCaL SAT Solver
text: Clauses use DIMACS conventions: means “variable true”, -means negation. terminating zero needed. NA model marks variable solver left unassigned either polarity extends model.
code: library(zusat)  # (x1 OR x2) AND (NOT x1 OR x2) AND (x1 OR NOT x2) s <- sat_solver() sat_add(s, c(1, 2)) sat_add(s, c(-1, 2)) sat_add(s, c(1, -2))  sat_solve(s) #> [1] "sat"  sat_model(s) #> [1] TRUE TRUE

title: R Bindings for the CaDiCaL SAT Solver
text: solver keeps state, can add clauses re-solve without rebuilding formula:
code: s <- sat_solver() sat_add(s, c(1, 2)) sat_solve(s)      #> "sat"  sat_add(s, -1) sat_add(s, -2) sat_solve(s)      #> "unsat"

title: R Bindings for the CaDiCaL SAT Solver
text: Assumptions hold single sat_solve() call. result "unsat", sat_failed() reports assumptions solver actually used — small unsatisfiable core assumptions:
code: s <- sat_solver() sat_add(s, c(1, 2))  sat_solve(s, assumptions = c(-1, -2))   #> "unsat" sat_failed(s, c(-1, -2))                #> TRUE TRUE  sat_solve(s)                            #> "sat" (assumptions did not persist)

title: R Bindings for the CaDiCaL SAT Solver
text: CaDiCaL exposes several hundred integer options:
code: sat_option(s, "elim")        # read sat_option(s, "elim", 0L)    # disable bounded variable elimination

title: R Bindings for the CaDiCaL SAT Solver
text: Long solves respond Ctrl-C. solver stops next safe point raises catchable R error; solver handle stays usable afterwards.

title: zusat: R Bindings for the 'CaDiCaL' SAT Solver — zusat-package
text: Solves Boolean satisfiability (SAT) problems using 'CaDiCaL', modern conflict-driven clause learning solver. Supports incremental solving, solving assumptions, inspection assumptions caused unsatisfiability. 'CaDiCaL' C++ sources bundled, external solver installation required.
